data.one_liner: Flutter support for the slang localization library.
data.what_it_does: Provides Flutter‑specific helpers for the slang code‑generated localization system. Adds BuildContext extensions to rebuild widgets on locale changes and RichText support. Offers utilities to use the device locale and list supported locales.
use_when: You already use the slang package for code‑generated translations
You need automatic widget rebuilds on locale change in Flutter
You want RichText support for localized strings
avoid_when: You are not using slang for localization
You need a full‑featured i18n solution with plural rules, date formatting, etc.
weaknesses: Works only with the slang package
Limited to the features it wraps

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: A standalone Flutter i18n solution without requiring slang code generation

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core code‑generation library; use it directly if you don’t need Flutter‑specific helpers
